uncited: *   **Point Primitive:** Vertices of each beam triangle are packed into a single point primitive.
**Stream-Out Feedback Loop:** Execute the geometry shader recursively.
The geometry shader receives point primitives representing beam vertices.
It performs adaptive subdivision based on geometric discontinuities, beam energy, and camera parameters (details in [Adaptive Beam Generation](9304-adaptive-beam-generation.md)).
The refined vertices are written back to the stream-out buffer.
The buffer is re-bound as input for the next iteration.
**Depth Attenuation:** During rasterization, calculate the difference between the screen-space depth of the caustic receiver and the depth value of the beam’s faces.
*   **Surface Caustics:** Requires an additional geometry buffer holding diffuse surface colors and view-space depth values of caustic receivers.
*   **Complexity:** The recursive nature requires multiple render passes (stream-out feedback), increasing overhead compared to single-pass geometry generation.
